headword: {計算手法|けいさんしゅほう}

definitions.explanation: A specific procedure or algorithm used to perform a calculation, especially in scientific, engineering, financial, or statistical contexts. Used when discussing the choice or comparison of methods rather than the act of calculating itself.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{計算手法|けいさんしゅほう}。
{従来|じゅうらい}の{計算手法|けいさんしゅほう}では{限界|げんかい}がある。
examples.english: The conventional calculation method has its limits.

examples.japanese: この{問題|もんだい}に{適|てき}した{計算手法|けいさんしゅほう}を{検討|けんとう}している。
examples.english: We are considering a calculation method suited to this problem.

examples.japanese: {機械学習|きかいがくしゅう}を{用|もち}いた{新|あたら}しい{計算手法|けいさんしゅほう}により、{処理|しょり}{速度|そくど}が{大幅|おおはば}に{向上|こうじょう}した。
examples.english: Thanks to a new computational technique using machine learning, processing speed has improved significantly.

notes:
Composed of {計算|けいさん} (calculation; computation) and {手法|しゅほう} (method; technique). The {手法|しゅほう} element signals "technique or approach," so the compound highlights the methodology rather than the numerical outcome.

USAGE:
Appears mainly in technical, academic, and business writing — in papers, engineering specifications, finance reports, and R&D discussions. In casual conversation, people simply say {計算|けいさん}のやり{方|かた} (how to calculate). Often modified by adjectives: {新|あたら}しい (new), {従来|じゅうらい}の (conventional), {高度|こうど}な (advanced), {効率的|こうりつてき}な (efficient).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新|あたら}しい{計算手法|けいさんしゅほう}: a new calculation method
- {計算手法|けいさんしゅほう}を{用|もち}いる: to employ a calculation method
- {計算手法|けいさんしゅほう}を{開発|かいはつ}する: to develop a calculation method
- {計算手法|けいさんしゅほう}の{改善|かいぜん}: improvement of the calculation method

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {計算方法|けいさんほうほう}: calculation method — a more general and everyday synonym; less technical than {計算手法|けいさんしゅほう}
- {計算|けいさん}アルゴリズム: calculation algorithm — emphasizes a formal step-by-step procedure
- {算出|さんしゅつ}{方法|ほうほう}: method of derivation — focuses on how a specific figure is obtained rather than the technique in general
